nd445e09523.headline: Nvidia turmoil weighs on PSEi; peso weakens
nd445e09523.summary: The local market tracked weakness across Asian equities, where reports about Nvidia's chief executive weighed on AI and semiconductor stocks. The peso also weakened, according to Philstocks Research.
nd445e09523.why: The Philippine Stock Exchange index tracks the country's listed companies, and the peso is the currency used across the Philippine economy.
nd445e09523.why_moved: Weakness across Asian equities, driven by reports surrounding Nvidia's chief executive, weighed on sentiment toward AI and semiconductor-related stocks.

n898c50d558.headline: Millions Join Spain Housing Strike, Scores Arrested in Clashes
n898c50d558.summary: Unions said more than 3 million Spaniards joined a mostly peaceful general strike over the housing crisis. Police arrested 115 people, mainly during evening clashes in Barcelona and Madrid.
n898c50d558.why: Spain's housing affordability, rents and mortgage conditions affect household spending, construction activity and the banks that lend against property.

n159c60a162.headline: Big bank spells out major housing construction drought
n159c60a162.summary: Westpac is financing 30 per cent fewer home builds and has more mortgage delinquencies, according to its bosses. The bank's comments point to a housing construction slowdown.
n159c60a162.why: Westpac is one of Australia's four major banks, and its mortgage and construction lending is a key indicator of the country's housing credit cycle.

n6b2dacbeb9.headline: Uzbekistan launches $220M solar project to power Navoiyazot
n6b2dacbeb9.summary: Uzbekistan has completed a $220 million solar power and energy storage project in the Navoi region. It will supply renewable electricity directly to Navoiyazot, one of the country's chemical producers.
n6b2dacbeb9.why: Navoiyazot is a major nitrogen fertiliser and chemicals producer, and on-site renewable power can lower its energy costs and emissions.

nf0bf61c6b5.headline: Azerbaijan targets non-oil primary deficit at 12% of non-oil GDP by 2030
nf0bf61c6b5.summary: Azerbaijan aims to reduce its consolidated budget's non-oil primary deficit to 12 per cent of non-oil GDP by 2030. The target is part of its fiscal consolidation plan.
nf0bf61c6b5.why: Azerbaijan is an oil and gas exporter, and its non-oil fiscal balance shows how far public finances depend on hydrocarbon revenue.

na0c4e702cf.headline: Thompson calls for tax holiday on toys as Christmas approaches and costs increase
na0c4e702cf.summary: Shadow Finance Minister J. Kwasi Thompson has called on the government to waive customs duty and VAT on qualifying children's toys in November and December. He cited rising Christmas costs.
na0c4e702cf.why: Customs duty and value-added tax changes alter retail prices and government tax revenue, which matter for consumer spending in small economies such as The Bahamas.

n7e7297bae5.headline: KazTransOil transports 8.37M tonnes of oil via Atyrau-Samara in 10M2026
n7e7297bae5.summary: KazTransOil transported 8.373 million tonnes of oil via the Atyrau-Samara section of the Uzen-Atyrau-Samara pipeline in January-October 2026, the company said.
n7e7297bae5.why: KazTransOil is Kazakhstan's national oil pipeline operator, and its throughput volumes indicate the flow of Kazakh crude to export markets.

n7afcb4574b.headline: Allot Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
n7afcb4574b.summary: Allot Ltd. announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results. The company is a provider of Security-as-a-Service and network intelligence products.
n7afcb4574b.why: Allot is a listed Israeli network security and intelligence provider, and its quarterly results show demand for its cybersecurity services.

n9724f3219e.headline: Armenia Rejects Legal Grounds for Possible EAEU Suspension, Finance Minister Says • MassisPost
n9724f3219e.summary: Armenian Finance Minister Vahe Hovhannisyan dismissed the legal arguments in a recent report on the possible suspension of Armenia's membership in the Eurasian Economic Union.
n9724f3219e.why: The Eurasian Economic Union is a trade bloc, and membership status affects customs rules and trade flows for its members, including Armenia.

n74c091ce90.headline: Maize price rises 7% as lean season bites
n74c091ce90.summary: Malawi's national average retail maize price rose seven percent in October 2026, according to IFPRI's Malawi Maize Market Report. The increase comes at the start of the lean season.
n74c091ce90.why: Maize is a staple food crop in Malawi, so its retail price directly affects household food costs and inflation in the country.

nf03205fe6c.headline: Nostrum’s Kazakhstan hydrocarbon processing up 13.26% in nine months
nf03205fe6c.summary: Nostrum Oil & Gas increased its average daily hydrocarbon processing volume in Kazakhstan by 13.26% year on year over nine months, according to the report.
nf03205fe6c.why: Nostrum is a UK-listed oil and gas company with operations in Kazakhstan, so its processing volumes indicate output from its Kazakh assets.

nace21a6861.headline: Slovakia’s AirExplore commences insolvency proceedings
nace21a6861.summary: AirExplore ceased all flight operations on 10 November 2026 and surrendered its operator certificate. It reported a 2025 net loss of about €22.4 million and plans to cut 109 jobs.
nace21a6861.why: AirExplore is a Slovak airline, and the case reflects financial strain in the small-carrier segment of European aviation.

naa52cf80a3.headline: Uzbekistan to Zero Tariffs on Mobile Phone Imports for WTO Accession
naa52cf80a3.summary: Uzbekistan agreed to zero tariffs on mobile phone imports as part of its 2026 WTO accession. The move is expected to cut consumer prices by 5%, while existing value-added tax is maintained.
naa52cf80a3.why: WTO accession sets trade rules for members, and tariff cuts on electronics change import costs and competition in the consumer market.

nc8927a34dd.summary: Elbit Systems was awarded a contract valued at $260 million to supply PULS rocket artillery systems to a European NATO country. The company is listed on Nasdaq and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
nc8927a34dd.why: Elbit Systems is an Israeli defense electronics and weapons company, and its contract wins reflect demand for artillery systems among NATO members.
